description: Source code for the ProtobufIRDiffDumper class, which handles serialization of IR diff data into protobuf format, including methods for adding various IR diff components and generating output.

classes.name: ProtobufIRDiffDumper
classes.description: Class responsible for dumping IR diff data into protobuf format, managing diff components, and outputting serialized data.

methods.name: AddLibNameIR
methods.description: Sets the library name in the diff protobuf.

methods.name: AddArchIR
methods.description: Sets the architecture in the diff protobuf.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStatusIR
methods.description: Calculates and returns the overall compatibility status based on the diff data.

methods.name: AddCompatibilityStatusIR
methods.description: Sets the compatibility status in the protobuf.

methods.name: AddDiffMessageIR
methods.description: Adds a diff message of various types to the protobuf based on message kind.

methods.name: AddLinkableMessageIR
methods.description: Adds linkable message diff components to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddElfSymbolMessageIR
methods.description: Adds ELF symbol diff components to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddElfFunctionIR
methods.description: Adds ELF function diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddElfObjectIR
methods.description: Adds ELF object diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddLoneRecordTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a record type diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddLoneFunctionDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a function diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddLoneEnumTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds an enum type diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddLoneGlobalVarDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a global variable diff component to the protobuf.

methods.name: AddRecordTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a record type diff with type stack info.

methods.name: AddFunctionDiffIR
methods.description: Adds a function diff with type stack info.

methods.name: AddEnumTypeDiffIR
methods.description: Adds an enum type diff with type stack info.

methods.name: Dump
methods.description: Serializes the protobuf data to the specified output file.
